FLEET-WIDE (user-confirmed 2026-06-12): it is a real progressive jackpot store that the CURRENT testspin interface forces to 0, so the sample correctly shows 0 on all machines. Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST140/ST50 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the interface is optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged.
